conflict_synopsis.core_view: AUDCAD's 1y/5y extreme is USD-contaminated CAD weakness, not a justified AU-CA premium, so own Australia-versus-Canada outside USD.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Further AU housing/labor/sentiment deterioration versus Canadian energy pass-through and firmer activity.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: AU housing/labor rebound while CA activity and energy pass-through fade and CA-AU 2Y re-justifies AUDCAD richness.

stance_summary: Short AUDCAD isolates Australian housing/RBA-channel stress versus Canadian energy pass-through and firmer activity; USD pairs contaminate both legs.

catalysts: Further Australian housing, stamp-duty, volumes, or Westpac-MI/labor deterioration
BoC communication or CPI that validates energy pass-through
Energy buffers remaining tight on the retained crude-near-$110 research
Any fading of USD-only CAD selling
trade.horizon: 2-8 weeks through subsequent Australian housing/labor/sentiment prints and Canadian inflation/BoC communication
trade.invalidation: Falsified if Australian housing, labor, and sentiment stabilize or rebound while Canadian activity and energy pass-through fade and the CA-AU 2Y spread leaves its 1y-median neighborhood for a new Australian-premium extreme.
trade.mispricing: AUDCAD prices a near-record Australian premium versus CAD while the CA-AU 2Y differential is only around its 1y median; the 1m AUDCAD rally is mechanically USD-CAD weakness after the Fed hike, not a clean AU-CA re-rating of housing versus energy.
principal_risks: Known adverse carry: AU 2Y 4.999 versus CA 2Y 3.27
Saudi workaround reduced the extreme oil-supply tail
Common commodity-beta shock can sell CAD with AUD
trade.thesis: AUDCAD's 1y-extreme richness still requires an Australian policy premium over Canada, but USD-driven CAD selling plus Australian housing stress left the cross too rich versus the actual AU-CA 2Y spread and growth/ToT mix. Verified 2026-09-18 ECB AUDCAD is 0.9976, 1y percentile 99.80, 5y percentile 99.96. The 1m move decomposes into AUDUSD +0.20% plus USDCAD +1.74%. CA-AU 2Y is only the 51st percentile at -164.9bp. Growth gauges favor CAD. NZ crosses are second-best because official NZ yields are unavailable.
why_now: Post-Fed global-tightening desk thesis is keeping USD bid; USDCAD +1.75% over 1m is polluting CAD and stretching AUDCAD.
Australian housing transmission is in the latest retained prints plus the 16 Sep Westpac-MI confidence drop.
BoC minutes flag energy pass-through while Canadian core stays near 2% and activity/GDP are firmer than Australia's.
AUDNZD is more statistically stretched but NZ official yields are a hard gap.
